comments.body:
Instead of doing force install, updating the version to the following works. We'll need to later check if it breaks anything 
    "chart.js": "^4.1.1",
    "chartjs-plugin-zoom": "^2.2.0",

code_window:
1  FROM node:20-slim
     2  
     3  # Install system dependencies
     4  RUN apt-get update && \
     5      apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
     6      ca-certificates \
     7      bzip2 \
     8      curl \
     9      && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
    10  
    11  ARG PUBLIC_URL_ARG=
    12  ENV PUBLIC_URL=$PUBLIC_URL_ARG
    13  
    14  # Use build arguments to detect target platform
    15  ARG TARGETPLATFORM
    16  ARG TARGETARCH
    17  
    18  # Set to "false" to skip Python/STAC services (faster builds)
    19  ARG WITH_STAC=true
    20  ENV WITH_STAC=$WITH_STAC
    21  
    22  #############################
    23  # Micromamba (for Python)
    24  #############################
    25  
    26  RUN if [ "$WITH_STAC" = "true" ]; then \
    27          mkdir -p /opt/micromamba/bin && \
    28          MICROMAMBA_URL="https://micro.mamba.pm/api/micromamba/linux-64/latest" && \
    29          if [ "${TARGETARCH}" = "arm64" ]; then \
    30              MICROMAMBA_URL="https://micro.mamba.pm/api/micromamba/linux-aarch64/latest"; \
    31          elif [ -z "${TARGETARCH}" ]; then \
    32              echo "TARGETARCH is empty, defaulting to amd64"; \
    33          fi && \
    34          echo "Downloading micromamba for ${TARGETARCH} from: ${MICROMAMBA_URL}" && \
    35          curl -Ls "${MICROMAMBA_URL}" | tar -C /opt/micromamba -xvj bin/micromamba && \
    36          MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX="/opt/micromamba" /opt/micromamba/bin/micromamba shell init -s bash && \
    37          echo 'export PATH="/opt/micromamba/bin:$PATH"' >> /root/.bashrc && \
    38          echo 'export MAMBA_ROOT_PREFIX="/opt/micromamba"' >> /root/.bashrc; \
    39      else \
    40          echo "Skipping Python/STAC installation (WITH_STAC=false)"; \
    41      fi
    42  
    43  #############################
    44  # Python environment
    45  #############################
    46  
    47  WORKDIR /usr/src/app
    48  
    49  # Copy only python env file first (cached unless this file changes)
    50  COPY python-environment.yml ./
    51  RUN if [ "$WITH_STAC" = "true" ]; then \
post_comment_delta:
diff --git a/Dockerfile b/Dockerfile
index 672ab9fc..598a440b 100644
--- a/Dockerfile
+++ b/Dockerfile
@@ -60,10 +60,9 @@ RUN if [ "$WITH_STAC" = "true" ]; then \
 
 # Copy only package files first (cached unless these change)
 COPY package*.json ./
-# --force matches the documented local install. The chart.js semver conflict
-# (react-chartjs-2@5 wants ^4.1.1; chartjs-plugin-zoom@1.2.1 pins ^3.2.0) is
-# tracked as follow-up #2 in the LayerManager refactor handoff. Don't switch
-# to --legacy-peer-deps; it silently drops @deck.gl/extensions and mesh-layers.
+# --force is required: react-chartjs-2@5 wants chart.js@^4.1.1, but
+# chartjs-plugin-zoom@1.2.1 pins ^3.2.0. Don't use --legacy-peer-deps; in this
+# tree it silently drops @deck.gl/extensions and @deck.gl/mesh-layers.
 RUN npm install --force
 
 #############################
